summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing a routine stock exchange announcement regarding director/PDMR shareholding. The filing notifies the vesting of share awards to four executives, including CEO Peter ter Kulve, on August 12, 2026, involving ordinary shares of €3.50 each at prices around €16.928 (Amsterdam) and £14.50 (London). Malus and clawback provisions apply. This is a standard equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic events are present. What to watch: none; routine administrative filing.
